name: Wetberry, the Breakroom Relic
description: A small white carton bearing red strawberry glyphs. It stands upright with too much confidence. The sides pulse gently when observed.

name: Evidence Bag of Not My Business
description: A sealable bag used to contain socially dangerous objects without becoming part of the story. The warning labels warn of HR violations.

name: Damp Napkin
description: A napkin that has seen the edge of the Undercorporate. It still carries a faint smell of office coffee and ancient frost.

name: Ancient Mayonnaise
description: A heavy glass jar of mayonnaise whose expiration date predates written history. A swirling void rotates beneath the yellow lid.

name: Accountability Token
description: A heavy, brass token stamped with the word 'ACKNOWLEDGED'. It feels cold to the touch and hums with soft hold music.

name: Condiment Sigil
description: A crystallized emblem of ketchup and mustard, granted by the Condiment Guardian to those who prove respect for forgotten flavors. Opens the path through the Leftover Catacombs.

name: Freezer Blessing
description: A shimmering frost-token from the Freezer Shrine. It preserves the warmth of acknowledgment against the cold of neglect. Required to approach the Sentient Casserole without triggering its defenses.

name: Casserole Lid Fragment
description: A cracked piece of the Sentient Casserole's original lid, given freely after resolution. It bears the faded label of a 2007 potluck. Proof that even the most resentful leftovers can be acknowledged.

name: Writ of Summons
description: A folded notice with your name spelled almost correctly. It smells faintly of the breakroom fridge.

name: Evidence Ledger
description: A ledger of every strange thing that has happened near the breakroom, cross-referenced by smell.

name: Verdict Seal
description: A warm wax seal pressed with a shape that isn't quite a strawberry and isn't quite a gavel. It means the hearing is over. It does not mean it was fair.

name: Bagged Wetberry Evidence
description: Wetberry sealed inside Keith’s Evidence Bag. It is quieter now, but the bag occasionally fogs from the inside.
